properties.perspective: High oblique aerial vantage looking southwest across the rolling alluvial floodplain and moraine terraces of Strathspey toward the Cairngorm mountain foothills.

properties.topsoil: Humic podzols and peaty alluvium, free-draining sandy loam over glacial gravels
properties.subsoil: Quaternary glaciofluvial outwash, sand, and gravel deposits
properties.bedrock: Neoproterozoic Dalradian Supergroup metasediments and Central Highlands Grampian Group psammite/schist with granite intrusions

surfaces: Compacted crushed quartzite and granitic farm tracks with muddy ruts and grassy central verges
Hardstanding concrete yard and gravel aprons around the modern steel-framed agricultural sheds
Pasture fields subdivided by wire-fenced post-and-rail borders and low drystone dyke field margins

properties.canopy: Scattered stands of Scots Pine (Pinus sylvestris), Silver Birch (Betula pendula) displaying golden autumn senescent foliage, rowan, and dense riparian gorse and broom along field fringes
properties.ground_cover: Rough pasture grasses (Festuca, Agrostis) mixed with patches of Calluna vulgaris heather and damp rush (Juncus effusus) in field hollows

structures.materials: Corrugated fiber cement and rusted steel profile sheet roofing, dark timber/metal clad siding, steel portal frame structure
Whitewashed rubble stone masonry with Ballachulish slate roofs, traditional pitched gables, chimney stacks, and timber sash frames
Low profile tin/slate pitched roof outbuilding adjacent to trackway

properties.conditions: Low golden hour autumn sunlight skimming across Strathspey, casting long raking cast shadows eastward from agricultural buildings and terrain crests, with faint peat smoke haze in the cool Highland air
